dct_description_sm: The District Municipality of Muskoka's Lake System Health Water Quality Monitoring Program tracks long-term trends in water quality to support the creation of policies in Muskoka’s Official Plan to guide development around Muskoka area lakes to ensure that the water quality in lakes remains able to support Muskoka's flora, fauna, communities and economy.
dct_title_s: The District Municipality of Muskoka Lake System Health Water Quality Monitoring Program Data
